NKJV.1: Then the LORD said to Noah, “Come into the ark, you and all your household, because I have seen that you are righteous before Me in this generation.
NKJV.2: You shall take with you seven each of every clean animal, a male and his female; two each of animals that are unclean, a male and his female;
NKJV.3: also seven each of birds of the air, male and female, to keep the species alive on the face of all the earth.
NKJV.4: For after seven more days I will cause it to rain on the earth forty days and forty nights, and I will destroy from the face of the earth all living things that I have made.”
NKJV.5: And Noah did according to all that the LORD commanded him.
NKJV.6: Noah was six hundred years old when the floodwaters were on the earth.
NKJV.7: So Noah, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, went into the ark because of the waters of the flood.
NKJV.8: Of clean animals, of animals that are unclean, of birds, and of everything that creeps on the earth,
NKJV.9: two by two they went into the ark to Noah, male and female, as God had commanded Noah.
NKJV.10: And it came to pass after seven days that the waters of the flood were on the earth.
NKJV.11: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, on that day all the fountains of the great deep were broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.
NKJV.12: And the rain was on the earth forty days and forty nights.
NKJV.13: On the very same day Noah and Noah’s sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth, and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered the ark—
NKJV.14: they and every beast after its kind, all cattle after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.
NKJV.15: And they went into the ark to Noah, two by two, of all flesh in which is the breath of life.
NKJV.16: So those that entered, male and female of all flesh, went in as God had commanded him; and the LORD shut him in.
NKJV.17: Now the flood was on the earth forty days. The waters increased and lifted up the ark, and it rose high above the earth.
NKJV.18: The waters prevailed and greatly increased on the earth, and the ark moved about on the surface of the waters.
NKJV.19: And the waters prevailed exceedingly on the earth, and all the high hills under the whole heaven were covered.
NKJV.20: The waters prevailed fifteen cubits upward, and the mountains were covered.
NKJV.21: And all flesh died that moved on the earth: birds and cattle and beasts and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.
NKJV.22: All in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, all that was on the dry land, died.
NKJV.23: So He destroyed all living things which were on the face of the ground: both man and cattle, creeping thing and bird of the air. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah and those who were with him in the ark remained alive.
NKJV.24: And the waters prevailed on the earth one hundred and fifty days.

ESV.1: Then the LORD said to Noah, “Go into the ark, you and all your household, for I have seen that you are righteous before me in this generation.
ESV.2: Take with you seven pairs of all clean animals,  the male and his mate, and a pair of the animals that are not clean, the male and his mate,
ESV.3: and seven pairs  of the birds of the heavens also, male and female, to keep their offspring alive on the face of all the earth.
ESV.4: For in seven days I will send rain on the earth forty days and forty nights, and every living thing  that I have made I will blot out from the face of the ground.”
ESV.5: And Noah did all that the LORD had commanded him.
ESV.6: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came upon the earth.
ESV.7: And Noah and his sons and his wife and his sons' wives with him went into the ark to escape the waters of the flood.
ESV.8: Of clean animals, and of animals that are not clean, and of birds, and of everything that creeps on the ground,
ESV.9: two and two, male and female, went into the ark with Noah, as God had commanded Noah.
ESV.10: And after seven days the waters of the flood came upon the earth.
ESV.11: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on that day all the fountains of the great deep burst forth, and the windows of the heavens were opened.
ESV.12: And rain fell upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
ESV.13: On the very same day Noah and his sons, Shem and Ham and Japheth, and Noah's wife and the three wives of his sons with them entered the ark,
ESV.14: they and every beast, according to its kind, and all the livestock according to their kinds, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, according to its kind, and every bird, according to its kind, every winged creature.
ESV.15: They went into the ark with Noah, two and two of all flesh in which there was the breath of life.
ESV.16: And those that entered, male and female of all flesh, went in as God had commanded him. And the LORD shut him in.
ESV.17: The flood continued forty days on the earth. The waters increased and bore up the ark, and it rose high above the earth.
ESV.18: The waters prevailed and increased greatly on the earth, and the ark floated on the face of the waters.
ESV.19: And the waters prevailed so mightily on the earth that all the high mountains under the whole heaven were covered.
ESV.20: The waters prevailed above the mountains, covering them fifteen cubits  deep.
ESV.21: And all flesh died that moved on the earth, birds, livestock, beasts, all swarming creatures that swarm on the earth, and all mankind.
ESV.22: Everything on the dry land in whose nostrils was the breath of life died.
ESV.23: He blotted out every living thing that was on the face of the ground, man and animals and creeping things and birds of the heavens. They were blotted out from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ark.
ESV.24: And the waters prevailed on the earth 150 days.

NASB.1: Then the LORD said to Noah, 'Enter the ark, you and all your household, for you [alone] I have seen [to be] righteous before Me in this time.
NASB.2: 'You shall take with you of every clean animal by sevens, a male and his female; and of the animals that are not clean two, a male and his female;
NASB.3: also of the birds of the sky, by sevens, male and female, to keep offspring alive on the face of all the earth.
NASB.4: 'For after seven more days, I will send rain on the earth forty days and forty nights; and I will blot out from the face of the land every living thing that I have made.'
NASB.5: Noah did according to all that the LORD had commanded him.
NASB.6: Now Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of water came upon the earth.
NASB.7: Then Noah and his sons and his wife and his sons' wives with him entered the ark because of the water of the flood.
NASB.8: Of clean animals and animals that are not clean and birds and everything that creeps on the ground,
NASB.9: there went into the ark to Noah by twos, male and female, as God had commanded Noah.
NASB.10: It came about after the seven days, that the water of the flood came upon the earth.
NASB.11: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on the same day all the fountains of the great deep burst open, and the floodgates of the sky were opened.
NASB.12: The rain fell upon the earth for forty days and forty nights.
NASB.13: On the very same day Noah and Shem and Ham and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah's wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered the ark,
NASB.14: they and every beast after its kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, all sorts of birds.
NASB.15: So they went into the ark to Noah, by twos of all flesh in which was the breath of life.
NASB.16: Those that entered, male and female of all flesh, entered as God had commanded him; and the LORD closed [it] behind him.
NASB.17: Then the flood came upon the earth for forty days, and the water increased and lifted up the ark, so that it rose above the earth.
NASB.18: The water prevailed and increased greatly upon the earth, and the ark floated on the surface of the water.
NASB.19: The water prevailed more and more upon the earth, so that all the high mountains everywhere under the heavens were covered.
NASB.20: The water prevailed fifteen cubits higher, and the mountains were covered.
NASB.21: All flesh that moved on the earth perished, birds and cattle and beasts and every swarming thing that swarms upon the earth, and all mankind;
NASB.22: of all that was on the dry land, all in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, died.
NASB.23: Thus He blotted out every living thing that was upon the face of the land, from man to animals to creeping things and to birds of the sky, and they were blotted out from the earth; and only Noah was left, together with those that were with him in the ark.
NASB.24: The water prevailed upon the earth one hundred and fifty days.

NLT.1: When everything was ready, the LORD said to Noah, “Go into the boat with all your family, for among all the people of the earth, I can see that you alone are righteous.
NLT.2: Take with you seven pairs — male and female — of each animal I have approved for eating and for sacrifice, and take one pair of each of the others.
NLT.3: Also take seven pairs of every kind of bird. There must be a male and a female in each pair to ensure that all life will survive on the earth after the flood.
NLT.4: Seven days from now I will make the rains pour down on the earth. And it will rain for forty days and forty nights, until I have wiped from the earth all the living things I have created.”
NLT.5: So Noah did everything as the LORD commanded him.
NLT.6: Noah was 600 years old when the flood covered the earth.
NLT.7: He went on board the boat to escape the flood — he and his wife and his sons and their wives.
NLT.8: With them were all the various kinds of animals — those approved for eating and for sacrifice and those that were not — along with all the birds and the small animals that scurry along the ground.
NLT.9: They entered the boat in pairs, male and female, just as God had commanded Noah.
NLT.10: After seven days, the waters of the flood came and covered the earth.
NLT.11: When Noah was 600 years old, on the seventeenth day of the second month, all the underground waters erupted from the earth, and the rain fell in mighty torrents from the sky.
NLT.12: The rain continued to fall for forty days and forty nights.
NLT.13: That very day Noah had gone into the boat with his wife and his sons — Shem, Ham, and Japheth — and their wives.
NLT.14: With them in the boat were pairs of every kind of animal — domestic and wild, large and small — along with birds of every kind.
NLT.15: Two by two they came into the boat, representing every living thing that breathes.
NLT.16: A male and female of each kind entered, just as God had commanded Noah. Then the LORD closed the door behind them.
NLT.17: For forty days the floodwaters grew deeper, covering the ground and lifting the boat high above the earth.
NLT.18: As the waters rose higher and higher above the ground, the boat floated safely on the surface.
NLT.19: Finally, the water covered even the highest mountains on the earth,
NLT.20: rising more than twenty-two feet above the highest peaks.
NLT.21: All the living things on earth died — birds, domestic animals, wild animals, small animals that scurry along the ground, and all the people.
NLT.22: Everything that breathed and lived on dry land died.
NLT.23: God wiped out every living thing on the earth — people, livestock, small animals that scurry along the ground, and the birds of the sky. All were destroyed. The only people who survived were Noah and those with him in the boat.
NLT.24: And the floodwaters covered the earth for 150 days.

CSB17.1: Then the LORD said to Noah, “Enter the ark, you and all your household, for I have seen that you alone are righteous before me in this generation. <sup>ⓙ</sup>
CSB17.2: You are to take with you seven pairs, a male and its female, of all the clean animals, <sup>ⓚ</sup> and two of the animals that are not clean, a male and its female,
CSB17.3: and seven pairs, male and female, of the birds of the sky — in order to keep offspring alive throughout the earth.
CSB17.4: Seven days from now I will make it rain on the earth forty days and forty nights, and every living thing I have made I will wipe off the face of the earth.”
CSB17.5: And Noah did everything that the LORD commanded him. <sup>ⓛ</sup>
CSB17.6: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood came and water covered the earth.
CSB17.7: So Noah, his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives entered the ark because of the floodwaters.
CSB17.8: From the clean animals, unclean animals, birds, and every creature that crawls on the ground,
CSB17.9: two of each, male and female, came to Noah and entered the ark, just as God had commanded him.
CSB17.10: Seven days later the floodwaters came on the earth.
CSB17.11: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on that day all the sources of the vast watery depths burst open, <sup>ⓜ</sup> the floodgates of the sky were opened, <sup>ⓝ</sup>
CSB17.12: and the rain fell on the earth forty days and forty nights.
CSB17.13: On that same day Noah along with his sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth, Noah’s wife, and his three sons’ wives entered the ark with him.
CSB17.14: They entered it with all the wildlife according to their kinds, all livestock according to their kinds, all the creatures that crawl on the earth according to their kinds, every flying creature — all the birds and every winged creature — according to their kinds.
CSB17.15: Two of every creature that has the breath of life in it came to Noah and entered the ark.
CSB17.16: Those that entered, male and female of every creature, entered just as God had commanded him. Then the LORD shut him in.
CSB17.17: The flood continued for forty days on the earth; the water increased and lifted up the ark so that it rose above the earth.
CSB17.18: The water surged and increased greatly on the earth, and the ark floated on the surface of the water.
CSB17.19: Then the water surged even higher on the earth, and all the high mountains under the whole sky were covered.
CSB17.20: The mountains were covered as the water surged above them more than twenty feet. <sup>[1]</sup>
CSB17.21: Every creature perished — those that crawl on the earth, birds, livestock, wildlife, and those that swarm <sup>[2]</sup> on the earth, as well as all mankind.
CSB17.22: Everything with the breath of the spirit of life in its nostrils <sup>ⓐ</sup>  — everything on dry land died.
CSB17.23: He wiped out every living thing that was on the face of the earth, from mankind to livestock, to creatures that crawl, to the birds of the sky, and they were wiped off the earth. Only Noah was left, and those that were with him in the ark. <sup>ⓑ</sup>
CSB17.24: And the water surged on the earth 150 days.

WEB.1: Yahweh said to Noah, “Come with all of your household into the ship, for I have seen your righteousness before me in this generation.
WEB.2: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean, take two, the male and his female.
WEB.3: Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.
WEB.4: In seven days, I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I will destroy every living thing that I have made from the surface of the ground.”
WEB.5: Noah did everything that Yahweh commanded him.
WEB.6: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth.
WEB.7: Noah went into the ship with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, because of the floodwaters.
WEB.8: Clean animals, unclean animals, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground
WEB.9: went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.
WEB.10: After the seven days, the floodwaters came on the earth.
WEB.11: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on the same day all the fountains of the great deep were burst open, and the sky’s windows were opened.
WEB.12: It rained on the earth forty days and forty nights.
WEB.13: In the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth — the sons of Noah — and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ship —
WEB.14: they, and every animal after its kind, all the livestock after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.
WEB.15: Pairs from all flesh with the breath of life in them went into the ship to Noah.
WEB.16: Those who went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; then Yahweh shut him in.
WEB.17: The flood was forty days on the earth. The waters increased, and lifted up the ship, and it was lifted up above the earth.
WEB.18: The waters rose, and increased greatly on the earth; and the ship floated on the surface of the waters.
WEB.19: The waters rose very high on the earth. All the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered.
WEB.20: The waters rose fifteen cubits  higher, and the mountains were covered.
WEB.21: All flesh died that moved on the earth, including birds, livestock, animals, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.
WEB.22: All on the dry land, in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, died.
WEB.23: Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and birds of the sky. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ship.
WEB.24: The waters flooded the earth one hundred fifty days.

AMP.1: Then the LORD said to Noah, "Come into the ark, you with all your household, for you [alone] I have seen as righteous (doing what is right) before Me in this generation.
AMP.2: Of every clean animal you shall take with you seven pair, the male and his female, and of animals that are not clean, two each the male and his female;
AMP.3: also of the birds of the air, seven pair, the male and the female, to keep the offspring alive on the surface of the earth.
AMP.4: For in seven days I am going to cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights; and I will destroy (blot out, wipe away) every living thing that I have made from the surface of the earth."
AMP.5: So Noah did all that the LORD commanded him.
AMP.6: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood (deluge) of water came on the earth [covering all of the land].
AMP.7: Then Noah and his sons and his wife and his sons' wives with him entered the ark to escape the flood waters.
AMP.8: Of clean animals and animals that are not clean and birds and fowls and everything that crawls on the ground,
AMP.9: they came [motivated by God] into the ark with Noah two by two, the male and the female, just as God had commanded Noah.

NIV.1: The Lord then said to Noah, “Go into the ark, you and your whole family, because I have found you righteous in this generation.

NIV.5: And Noah did all that the Lord commanded him.
NIV.6: Noah was six hundred years old when the floodwaters came on the earth.
NIV.7: And Noah and his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives entered the ark to escape the waters of the flood.

NET.1: The LORD said to Noah, “Come into the ark, you and all your household, for I consider you godly among this generation.

NET.5: And Noah did all that the LORD commanded him.

NET.9: male and female, came into the ark to Noah, just as God had commanded him.
NET.10: And after seven days the floodwaters engulfed the earth.
